featured.title: Veteran Nollywood Actor Taiwo Hassan 'Ogogo' Dies At 66
featured.content: Veteran Yoruba Nollywood actor Taiwo Hassan, widely known as Ogogo, has died at the age of 66. His death was announced by his daughter on Sunday after the actor had been battling stage-four cancer. Nigerian entertainment organisations and public figures have paid tribute to the veteran actor, whose career in the Yoruba film industry spanned more than four decades. His burial is scheduled to take place in Ilaro, Ogun State, on Monday.
featured.source: Vanguard News / Channels Television / Punch Newspapers

articles.title: Taiwo Hassan 'Ogogo' Dies At 66
articles.description: Veteran Yoruba Nollywood actor Taiwo Hassan, popularly known as Ogogo, has died at 66 after battling stage-four cancer. His daughter confirmed his death on Sunday. Tributes have continued across Nigeria's entertainment industry.
articles.source: Vanguard News / Channels Television / Punch Newspapers

articles.title: Scores Abducted In Coordinated Niger State Attacks
articles.description: Armed groups attacked several villages in Niger State, including a mosque in Kpenya village. Police confirmed the attacks but did not provide an exact number of people abducted. Residents and local authorities estimated that between 60 and 80 people may have been taken.

articles.title: Security Forces Search For Niger State Abduction Victims
articles.description: The Nigerian military has been deployed following coordinated attacks in Borgu Local Government Area. No deaths were officially confirmed in the attacks, although some people reportedly suffered gunshot injuries while trying to escape.

articles.title: Nigeria's Security Situation Remains A Major Concern
articles.description: Kidnapping and armed attacks remain major security concerns in several parts of Nigeria. The latest Niger State attacks have renewed calls for stronger protection of vulnerable communities and faster emergency response.

articles.title: European Allies Gather In Kyiv To Support Ukraine
articles.description: European leaders are meeting in Kyiv as Ukraine seeks additional air-defence systems and stronger security assistance. The meeting is also focused on maintaining pressure on Moscow and supporting Ukraine's long-term defence.

articles.title: Ukraine Faces Continuing Air-Defence Shortages
articles.description: Ukraine continues to press its allies for more missile interceptors as Russian missile and drone attacks intensify. Ukrainian officials say deliveries of air-defence missiles have fallen significantly compared with previous years.

articles.title: North Korea Reportedly Prepares Further Russia Deployment
articles.description: South Korea's Defense Ministry says North Korea appears to be preparing another deployment of personnel to Russia. Seoul says there is currently no indication that the new deployment is imminent. Pyongyang has already provided substantial military support to Moscow.

articles.title: Gaza: Fresh Israeli Airstrikes Reported
articles.description: Palestinian health officials say Israeli airstrikes in Gaza killed at least two people, including a four-year-old boy, and injured seven others. Israel said its actions followed attacks involving drones, kites and balloons launched from Gaza.

articles.title: EU Sends Firefighting Assistance To Serbia
articles.description: The European Union has deployed helicopters, firefighters and equipment to Serbia through the EU Civil Protection Mechanism. The assistance comes as major wildfires continue to threaten areas of the country.

articles.title: European Wildfire Crisis Continues
articles.description: Wildfires have affected several European countries during an exceptionally hot and dry summer. Belgium, Greece, Spain, Croatia, Portugal and Serbia have all faced serious fire emergencies this season.

articles.title: NASA Documents Europe's Record-Breaking Summer Heat
articles.description: NASA reports that Europe experienced repeated heatwaves during 2026, with temperatures exceeding 40°C in parts of Western Europe. The extreme heat has worsened drought, wildfire risks and pressure on infrastructure.

articles.title: India Says No New H1N1 Strain Detected
articles.description: The Indian Council of Medical Research says there is no new H1N1 strain currently circulating in India. Health authorities say the recent increase in cases is consistent with seasonal influenza and have urged the public not to panic.

articles.title: Global Markets Watch Geopolitical Risks
articles.description: Investors continue monitoring oil prices, government bond yields, inflation expectations and geopolitical developments as markets assess the economic consequences of conflicts and extreme weather.

articles.title: Energy Security Remains A Global Concern
articles.description: Developments surrounding the Middle East and the Strait of Hormuz continue to influence energy markets. Investors remain concerned about possible disruptions to oil supplies and the impact on inflation and transportation costs.

articles.title: AI Infrastructure Investment Remains Strong
articles.description: Artificial intelligence continues to attract major investment as technology companies expand computing infrastructure and governments consider new rules for AI development, safety and deployment.

articles.title: Humanoid Robotics Moves Toward Practical Applications
articles.description: Chinese robotics companies continue demonstrating humanoid machines performing practical tasks in factories, warehouses and other environments as the industry works toward broader commercial adoption.

articles.title: Climate Risks Continue To Grow
articles.description: Extreme heat, drought and wildfires are placing growing pressure on communities, agriculture, water supplies and emergency services. Scientists and governments continue calling for stronger climate resilience and preparedness.

articles.title: Today's Big Question
articles.description: As insecurity, economic pressure, extreme weather and geopolitical tensions continue across the world, what should governments focus on most — protecting lives, creating jobs or improving living standards? Share your opinion in the comments.

articles.title: Inspirational Quote Of The Day
articles.description: Every new morning is a reminder that yesterday has passed, but your opportunity to do something meaningful is still alive. 🌅
